scope: Independent source review of cost/admission/recovery and continuation-target mathematics; local contract fixtures only.

resolved_findings.issue: A process death left an exclusive-create lock permanently blocking selection and rollback.
resolved_findings.resolution: Held OS lock on a persistent inode; process death releases ownership.
resolved_findings.verification: Local process-death and concurrent-writer contract test passed.

resolved_findings.issue: Negative owned-memory peaks and negative stage measurements could pass receipt validation.
resolved_findings.resolution: Receipt validation checks finite nonnegative metrics, integral peaks/counters, known stages, and attribution bounded by total time.
resolved_findings.verification: Malformed receipt rejection checked; local test suite passed.

resolved_findings.issue: Invalid GPU/energy telemetry consumed the meter before failure.
resolved_findings.resolution: Validate external telemetry before releasing residents or marking the meter finished.
resolved_findings.verification: Invalid telemetry preserves a reusable open meter.

resolved_findings.issue: String exclusion lists, invalid resource budgets and boolean information identities bypassed structural checks.
resolved_findings.resolution: Explicit source lists, valid measured budget bounds, actual budget consumption, and SHA-256 information identities are required.
resolved_findings.verification: Adversarial cases rejected after changes; local suite passed.

resolved_findings.issue: Cancellation in exponential subtraction falsely admitted an exact margin tie at a large common reward offset.
resolved_findings.resolution: Common-offset scaling, stable sign-dependent expm1, and finite test-range checks.
resolved_findings.verification: gamma=5e-16, returns=[1e16,1e16+2], margin=2 now yields exactly zero test mean and no-update.

resolved_findings.issue: Mutable external model paths and missing parent-directory fsync weakened rollback custody.
resolved_findings.resolution: Content-addressed retained bytes, verified loads/rollback, file and directory fsync, atomic active-manifest replacement.
resolved_findings.verification: Rollback survives mutation of the original source file; retained-file corruption fails closed.

resolved_findings.issue: Renaming source IDs could reuse confirmation evidence.
resolved_findings.resolution: Frozen original-content manifest, training-content exclusion, within-panel content disjointness, and consumption keyed by both raw-content and visible-information hashes.
resolved_findings.verification: Current regression rejects rename-only reuse and permits a fixture only after changing both original-content and input identities.

resolved_findings.issue: Continuation target subtraction could overflow for an accepted nonrepresentable return width.
resolved_findings.resolution: Reject nonfinite upper-minus-lower return width; stable expm1 branches preserve the original moment-difference target.
resolved_findings.verification: gamma=1e-309 with bounds [-1e308,1e308] is now rejected; standard bounds remain accepted.

final_local_contract_suite.scope: Contract fixtures; not model efficacy evidence

continuation_target_math.method: Executed the actual target expression extracted from source AST and compared with 100-digit Decimal arithmetic.
passed_cases: large common offset with small gamma
continuation_target_math.overflowing_width: Rejected by the actual final _contract function extracted from source AST.

validation.rust_torch_hardware_run: Parent reported the separate desktop run was starting; its results were not available to this review.

assumptions: Candidate, baseline, objective, tariff, risk profile, sampling rules and bounds are frozen before confirmation.
The statistical bound requires independent source clusters including the relevant outcome/cost sampling; distinct image IDs alone do not prove hardware-load independence.
The external collector truthfully verifies source-content hashes and original collection times; a checksum and timestamp field are not independent authenticity evidence.

Qualification evidence is externally established. Hash binding and boolean completeness checks do not themselves measure coverage, calibration, unknown rejection, recovery or matched training budgets.
Measured residency covers explicit owned candidate/cache objects. Unregistered allocations, device memory and unavailable energy are not implicitly measured.
Confirmation consumption and artifact selection are local mechanisms; this review does not establish a distributed holdout owner or production authority.
source_changes_by_reviewer: None to the reviewed implementation files; findings were sent to their authors.
